title: Security Deposit Application to the Final Bill and Cancelled Start Orders
content:
**Closing of the secured agreement.** When the secured service agreement closes, a Security Deposit in held or assessed status is applied to its final balance on the final bill date, together with interest earned through that date, in the order of application set for its kind.

**Moving customers.** A deposit whose kind allows transfer on a move, and whose customer has opened a new service agreement before the closure, is moved instead of applied.

**Cancelled start orders.** When a start order is cancelled before the service began, the deposit is cancelled and any cash received is refunded in full.

**Posting of the application.** An application is posted only on a deposit in applied to final bill status, as the deposit record shows it.

## Outcome table at closing

| Deposit status at closing | Kind allows transfer and the customer opened a new agreement before the closure | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| Held | No | Applied to the final balance on the final bill date, with interest earned through that date |
| Assessed | No | Applied to the final balance on the final bill date |
| Held | Yes | Moved instead of applied |

## Hypothetical illustrations

1. A Residential Reestablishment Deposit is held when the customer closes the agreement without opening another. The deposit, with interest earned through the final bill date, is applied to the final balance on the final bill date.
2. A customer's start order is cancelled before service began, after the customer had paid a USD 40.00 first installment on a Residential New Service Deposit. The deposit is cancelled and the USD 40.00 is refunded in full.
